generic_sampling_rules.text_primary_key: fresh unique value per row; never NULL; no duplicates
generic_sampling_rules.text_fk: copy from the parent key pool (compact + generated); never NULL for NOT NULL FKs; 5-10% NULL only where the column is nullable; no orphan values (every non-NULL value must exist in the parent pool); validate FK targets before insert
generic_sampling_rules.text_free: sample from a small pool of realistic values; 20-50% duplicate share; 5-15% near-variants (case change, trailing space, one-char edit) of pool values
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: sample uniformly from the listed enum values; 20-50% duplicate share
generic_sampling_rules.text_money: format '$<int>,<3-digit groups>' with no decimals; value in [1, 3,000,000,000]; 20-50% duplicate share
generic_sampling_rules.text_date: format 'Mon D, YYYY' (e.g. 'Dec 21, 1937'); year in [1930, 2020]; 20-50% duplicate share
generic_sampling_rules.text_numeric_string: string of digits with optional comma thousands separators; 5-10% NULL where nullable
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_rule: for each listed literal L in a column's targets, include L, one step below and one step above (numbers by step 1, dates by one day, strings by case/whitespace variant)
generic_sampling_rules.like_near_variant_rule: for each listed LIKE literal, include the literal's prefix match, a one-character edit, a case variant, and a value that does not match
generic_sampling_rules.tie_rule: for each listed ORDER column and rank, include at least two rows with equal sort key at that rank; for ASC rank 1 the tie value must be the minimum of the generated range, for DESC rank 1 the maximum
generic_sampling_rules.null_rule: every nullable column gets at least one NULL row per instance; NULL share follows the compact database's null_rate for that column; planted NULLs are never replaced to satisfy a rule; NOT NULL and primary-key columns never get NULL
